nombre_oficial.texto: The Sacbé and the Sacred Cenote

frase_gancho.texto: The white road to the mouth of the underworld.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: North of El Castillo, a white causeway leads out toward the water. There are two stops: Sacbé Number One and the Sacred Cenote. The sacbé, about two hundred seventy meters long according to one general description, though other sources put it at about three hundred, connects the plaza with the cenote. The Sacred Cenote, sixty meters in diameter, received offerings of gold, copper, jade, ceramics, and copal for centuries, and people as well. Some of those offerings come from distant lands, which suggests that this place was known far beyond Yucatán.
